primary_metric: presence_auc_validate: AUC of P(cluster gets >=1 maker BUY fill on side s in 10-s bin) over all (BTC 5m window, side, bin in [0,300) s) of VALIDATE, point-in-time features, no own-state; from iteration 2 on the tape excludes every print in a cluster transaction (iteration-1 value 0.7723 was leaky; clean equivalent 0.7592)

hypotheses.description: fill prices track Binance 1-s fair value; scan of shift k in [-10,+6] s
hypotheses.verdict: no lead over public Binance 1-s data: prices best match spot ~1-2 s before the block timestamp (consistent with real-time public feed + block latency); no information wall

hypotheses.description: where is the cluster's bid when hit (600 sampled BUILD sweeps)
hypotheses.verdict: confirmed: top-of-book maker, usually alone at the best level; 85% of its fills are mint matches against takers buying the other side

hypotheses.description: side with last print > 0.5
hypotheses.verdict: rejected

hypotheses.description: fair_up > 0.5
hypotheses.verdict: rejected (weak)

hypotheses.description: side where Binance fair - last print is larger
hypotheses.verdict: partial: best single explicit rule

hypotheses.description: side whose bids were hit more in the last 10/30 s
hypotheses.verdict: rejected

hypotheses.description: sign of 10-s Binance return
hypotheses.verdict: rejected

hypotheses.description: presence per (window, side, 10-s bin) from time, Binance fair/returns/vol, taker tape state and flow
hypotheses.verdict: best so far (0.77); +0.04 over market activity alone; below the 0.85 target

hypotheses.description: H8 + own shares bought on each side before the bin
hypotheses.verdict: inventory matters (+0.05): consistent with inventory-skewed quoting; reported separately as required

hypotheses.description: fill price = last taker print on its side before the fill - 0.01 (0.01 grid)
hypotheses.verdict: weak; fill-time version reported by final_rule

hypotheses.description: three wallets = three instances of one bot
hypotheses.verdict: confirmed descriptively: same side signal, own size signature, rarely filled in the same taker order (2.5%)

hypotheses.description: edge and activity over time
hypotheses.verdict: VALIDATE is a different regime: activity fell ~60% and the BTC 5m maker edge turned negative

hypotheses.description: which windows the cluster trades, from public pre-window features (vol, hour, pre-window prints, |60s return|, previous window activity of the market)
hypotheses.verdict: unpredictable from public data (AUC 0.54); it is the main gap to the presence target: with oracle on/off the presence AUC would be 0.866

hypotheses.description: vol lookback 120-3600 s and vol scale 0.7-2.0; vol x1.4 (300-900 s) cuts MAD(price - fair) 0.068 -> 0.058
hypotheses.verdict: the fills look like a fair value with ~1.4x the 1-s realized vol, but it does not improve presence or side

hypotheses.family: book proxies from the taker tape
hypotheses.description: last bid-hit / ask-lift price per side, ages, fair minus them
hypotheses.verdict: no gain

hypotheses.description: which taker orders inside BTC 5m windows fill a cluster maker order (LightGBM, print-time features incl. the print's own size/price)
hypotheses.verdict: promising but not the brief's match_test (no rotation null, no stratification); print size is the top feature (book-depth mechanics)

hypotheses.description: drop every taker print in a transaction where a cluster wallet traded before computing features (brief rule)
hypotheses.verdict: fixed; all iteration-2 numbers use the clean tape

hypotheses.family: window path / side commitment from public path
hypotheses.description: edge at the first clean print, running max/mean/share-positive of the edge, fair and z at 10 s
hypotheses.verdict: small gain (side +0.014)

hypotheses.description: previous window's Binance proxy outcome (momentum), strike move between windows, previous window's print count
hypotheses.verdict: small gain; adopted (R2)

hypotheses.family: operator on/off: downtime vs per-market schedule
hypotheses.description: activity in other markets when BTC 5m is off; hour profile; public tape of on vs off windows
hypotheses.verdict: not downtime: a schedule invisible in public data (caps the no-own-state presence AUC)

hypotheses.description: first fills <= 6 s after the start: side vs sign(Binance spot at start - TWAP strike)
hypotheses.verdict: partial: strong only when the spot-strike gap is large; few windows

hypotheses.description: rotation by window index, side split, time split, sequencing of fills
hypotheses.verdict: rejected rotation/side split: three parallel copies, each working its own resting orders

hypotheses.description: price = last clean print - 0.01 vs last ask-lift - 0.01, last hit bid, floor(fair - m), LightGBM regression (+ own previous price)
hypotheses.verdict: last clean print - 0.01 is best; the within-second print order matters (stable data-api order)

hypotheses.description: which in-window taker prints fill the cluster: LightGBM (BUILD) on bin panel + print fields; strata price50 x time40 x side and window x price10 x time10 x side; rotation null
hypotheses.verdict: significant vs rotation null; recall/lift at the bar but AUC < 0.80; mostly print size/price mechanics (activity-only 0.743)

hypotheses.description: accuracy of the R2 side pick by time in window and model confidence
hypotheses.verdict: the side is decodable early and when the model is confident; late fills are close to the market baseline

hypotheses.description: dominant side of one-sided active windows (>= 70% shares) from the mean R2 presence per side over the first T s
hypotheses.verdict: significant (p < 1e-4) but far from 0.80

hypotheses.description: orders by orderHash: fills per order, sizes, how long an order keeps being filled, fair drift while it rests
hypotheses.verdict: orders are consumed within seconds; smaller 500/250/125 ladder in VALIDATE; requote rules not measurable from fills alone

data_sources: data-api activity of the 3 wallets 2026-10-08..H (.cache/re/directional-maker/activity_<name>.parquet; re-fetched locally in iteration 2)

data-api taker tapes [start-120, end) of all 4,032 BTC 5m windows (taker5m_day_<d>.parquet, ~430k rows/day; about half read from identical pulls in .cache/re/btc5m-bot/tapes)

on-chain OrderFilled logs of the 3 wallets, VALIDATE 2026-10-16..H via publicnode (chain_fills_1792108800_1792713600.parquet, 40,357 fills; re-fetched in iteration 2); BUILD logs and 600 sweep receipts only in iteration 1 (cloud)
wall_reason: partial wall for the presence metric only: which BTC 5m windows the cluster trades is an operator schedule (active elsewhere in 89-93% of its BTC 5m-off slots; VALIDATE on 74-75% of windows 12-20 UTC vs 38-40% 00-12 UTC) and on/off windows have the same public tape statistics; not an information wall on quotes (no lead over Binance 1-s)
